688c5862a45d35bc.description: About the Role The Red Sea Landscape Nursery is seeking a Director - Production to lead plant production at Botanica Red Sea. This full-time role, based in Riyadh, involves managing the growth and supply of plant material from the 180-hectare nursery, which has an annual production capacity of 8 million plants. The Director will oversee propagation, greenhouses, shade houses, flower and indoor plant production, the seed bank, and the native species program, while also leading R&D and biosecurity efforts. Role Context and Objectives This position is accountable for plant quality, availability, biosecurity, safety, and production costs. The Director ensures supply to the Commercial department at the assumed cost for both internal Red Sea Global (RSG) clients and external developments. The role requires joint planning with Nursery Operations for water, soil, logistics, and equipment, with key risks including plant losses from pests, disease, heat, biosecurity incursions, and changes in demand forecasts. Key Responsibilities Translate demand plans into production, import, and growing plans, achieving production volumes, plant readiness dates, germination, and survival targets. Manage live plant inventory and review plant Bills of Quantities (BOQs) for projects, confirming availability and lead times. Lead plant propagation, greenhouse and shade house operations, flower and food production, indoor plants, and the seed bank. Grow the native plant program and apply crop management practices to maximize quality and minimize losses. Own the Biosecurity Protocol, including inspection of incoming material, phytosanitary documentation, quarantine, and traceability. Lead the integrated pest and disease management (IPM) program and the R&D roadmap, ensuring compliance with MEWA requirements. Manage the direct cost budget for nursery production and R&D, controlling labor, materials, water, fuel, equipment, and wastage. Plan manpower, equipment, and materials, reporting utilization and productivity, and identifying cost and delivery risks. Lead managers, supervisors, horticulturists, and operatives, driving competency and training standards. Ensure zero-harm field operations, including permits, method statements, toolbox talks, PPE, and incident reporting. Follow and enforce all relevant Botanica and RSG Group policies, processes, and standard operating procedures. Apply and champion the safety, quality, and environmental management systems (ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001) and the compliance management system (ISO 37301). Identify and lead opportunities for continuous improvement in department systems, processes, and practices. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 15 years of relevant experience in plant production and nursery management. About Botanica Botanica, a subsidiary of Red Sea Global, specializes in providing sustainable greenery across Red Sea Global’s destinations. The company focuses on integrating new species with local flora and operates with a planet-first approach to sustainability. Since 2020, Botanica has cultivated over 5 million plants, with a goal of 30 million by 2030, contributing to the natural landscapes of The Red Sea & Amaala. Application Process Candidates interested in this Director - Production position are encouraged to apply.

688e20e6d7220400.description: About SGS SGS is a global leader in Testing, Inspection, and Certification, recognized for quality and integrity benchmarks. Role Overview SGS is seeking a Laboratory Supervisor Geochemistry / Mineral Laboratory for a full-time position in Makkah, Saudi Arabia. This role involves overseeing daily laboratory operations across Sample Preparation, Fire Assay, and Wet Chemistry/Instrumental sections. The supervisor will coordinate personnel, manage workflows, and provide technical guidance to ensure accurate results, efficient operations, and timely delivery in accordance with SGS standards and ISO/IEC 17025 requirements. The position requires 2-5 years of experience and strong practical knowledge of laboratory processes, particularly Wet Chemistry, alongside team leadership abilities and a commitment to safety, quality, and productivity. Key Responsibilities Supervise and coordinate daily activities across Sample Preparation, Fire Assay, and Wet Chemistry/Instrumental sections. Allocate workload, personnel, and resources to meet production targets and customer turnaround times. Provide hands-on technical support and guidance to Chemists, Technicians, and other laboratory personnel, with a focus on Wet Chemistry operations. Oversee sample digestion, solution and reagent preparation, dilutions, and related analytical processes. Monitor laboratory workflow, address operational challenges, and escalate significant technical or production issues to senior management. Support the training, guidance, and competency development of laboratory personnel. Ensure analytical methods, approved procedures, and work instructions are consistently followed. Support the operation and routine troubleshooting of laboratory instruments, including AAS, ICP, UV, and XRF. Ensure equipment checks, calibration/verification, and routine maintenance are completed and documented. Monitor analytical results and quality-control data, identify deviations, and escalate abnormalities for investigation. Analyze tender outcomes through win/loss reviews, pricing simulations, competitor insights, and debriefs to support future EP bid strategy. Prepare and share regular bids and tender performance metrics, dashboards, and reports with the Bids and Tendering Leader and relevant stakeholders. Identify and propose process improvement opportunities to strengthen tender quality, cycle time, compliance, and stakeholder experience. 68de81701861b649.description: نبذة عن الوظيفة تبحث شركة الخليج الطبي عن كاتب استعلامات مركز خدمة عملاء للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يهدف هذا الدور إلى تقديم الدعم الأساسي للعملاء من خلال الرد على الاستفسارات ومعالجة الطلبات باستخدام قنوات الاتصال المختلفة. المسؤوليات الرئيسية الرد على أسئلة واستعلامات العملاء الأساسية بوضوح ودقة. تقديم المشورة للعملاء حول منتجات المنشأة وخدماتها وسياساتها والمواضيع ذات الصلة. معالجة طلبات العملاء ومتطلباتهم الأساسية، مثل إرسال الرسائل أو النماذج أو الوثائق الأخرى، بالإضافة إلى معالجة المعاملات المالية. حل شكاوى العملاء الأساسية، وإحالة المشكلات الأكثر تعقيدًا إلى مسؤول الشكاوى أو الموظف المختص. تسجيل الاستعلامات والشكاوى المستلمة، والإبلاغ بالحلول المتخذة. الالتزام التام بالأدلة الإجرائية والسياسات والإجراءات المنظمة والتقيد بها. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال خدمة العملاء أو دور مماثل. القدرة على التواصل بفعالية عبر الهاتف والوسائل الإلكترونية. مهارات جيدة في حل المشكلات الأساسية. تفاصيل الوظيفة هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في مدينة الرياض. يتم تحديد الراتب بعد المقابلة. بيئة العمل يعمل كاتب الاستعلامات ضمن مركز خدمة العملاء، حيث يقدم الدعم المباشر للعملاء ويضمن معالجة استفساراتهم وطلباتهم بكفاءة ووفقًا للإجراءات المعتمدة. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذه الفرصة في شركة الخليج الطبي.

68f3cce7299ade49.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة المخالد للتجارة والمقاولات عن فني صيانة مبانٍ للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية دراسة خطط الصيانة الدورية، وتحديد المتطلبات اللازمة لتنفيذ أعمال الصيانة، ومتابعة سير العمل، بالإضافة إلى قياس الأعمال المنجزة وإعداد المطالبات المالية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة تفاصيل خطط الصيانة الدورية لمختلف الأبنية، وتحديد العيوب الفنية، ومناقشة طرق معالجتها مع المهندس المختص. إعداد قوائم بالمواد اللازمة لتنفيذ أعمال الصيانة المتنوعة، بالإضافة إلى تحديد الأدوات والمعدات والعمال المطلوبين لإنجاز المهام. متابعة تنفيذ أعمال الصيانة الدورية والطارئة، والتحقق من مطابقة الأعمال المنجزة للمخططات والمواصفات الفنية. توضيح تفاصيل المخططات للفرق العاملة، ومتابعة حضورهم، ورفع تقارير دورية حول الأعمال المنجزة. قياس الأعمال المنجزة، وحساب كمياتها، وتدقيقها، وإعداد المطالبات المالية بالتنسيق مع محاسب الكميات، وتسليم الأعمال لجهة الإشراف. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال صيانة المباني. القدرة على قراءة المخططات الفنية وفهمها. معرفة جيدة بمواد وأدوات ومعدات الصيانة المختلفة. المهارات والكفاءات مهارات تنظيمية وتخطيطية ممتازة. القدرة على التواصل الفعال مع فرق العمل والمهندسين. الدقة في حساب الكميات وإعداد التقارير المالية. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في مدينة الرياض. ستعمل ضمن فريق متخصص في صيانة المباني، وتتطلب متابعة ميدانية للأعمال. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات، وسيتم مناقشته خلال المقابلة الشخصية.

6802351519c2da3b.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة جود العلياء عن أمين مخزن للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية استلام المواد والسلع الواردة إلى المستودع، وتنظيمها وتخزينها، وصرفها للجهات المعنية، بالإضافة إلى المشاركة في عمليات جرد المخزون. هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويتطلب خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية استلام المواد المراد إدخالها للمستودعات والتأكد من مطابقتها للمواصفات المذكورة في طلبات الشراء أو التوريد أو العينات. تنظيم وترتيب البضائع والمعدات والمواد الأخرى الموردة إلى المستودع ووضعها في أماكنها الصحيحة وتثبيت البيانات الخاصة بها. تحضير المواد وتجهيزها وصرفها للجهات المعنية بموجب سندات صرف وفقاً لآلية الصرف المعتمدة. تحديد الاحتياجات من السلع والمواد عند وصول المخزون إلى حد الطلب. حفظ معاملات الإدخالات والإخراجات المتعلقة بالمستودع. المشاركة في جرد المخزون ومطابقة نتائج الجرد الفعلي لأرصدة الدفاتر والسجلات. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال أمين مخزن أو ما يعادله. القدرة على استلام المواد والتحقق من مطابقتها للمواصفات. مهارات تنظيمية عالية لترتيب وتخزين البضائع بكفاءة. المهارات المطلوبة الدقة والانتباه للتفاصيل في عمليات الجرد والتخزين. القدرة على العمل ضمن فريق. مهارات التواصل الفعال. بيئة العمل يقع مقر العمل في مدينة الرياض، وهو دور بدوام كامل ضمن فريق شركة جود العلياء. يلتزم أمين المخزن بالعمل وفقاً للإجراءات والسياسات المعتمدة لضمان سير العمليات بسلاسة وفعالية. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور غير معلن وسيتم مناقشته خلال عملية التوظيف. نشجع المتقدمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة على تقديم طلباتهم.

68159198690c3db3.description: About SYSTRA SYSTRA is a global engineering and consultancy group specializing in public transport and sustainable mobility. With over 10,300 employees, SYSTRA focuses on designing safe and sustainable transport solutions to connect communities, foster social inclusion, and facilitate access to employment, education, and leisure worldwide. For 65 years, SYSTRA has partnered with cities and regions to develop, improve, and modernize infrastructure and transport systems across the project lifecycle, from design to testing, deployment, and maintenance. Operating in over 80 countries, SYSTRA generates 74% of its turnover internationally and supports clients in their digital, ecological, and energy transitions. Project Delivery Manager (Rail) Bid Opportunity This role is for a Project Delivery Manager (Rail) based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This is a full-time position requiring over 10 years of experience. This requirement is for a bid opportunity only at this stage; any engagement will be subject to successful project award and final client approval. The Project Delivery Manager will be responsible for leading the successful delivery of conventional railway and freight rail programs, with a strong focus on construction execution, package coordination, interface management, and delivery performance. Role Overview The Project Delivery Manager will lead the successful delivery of conventional railway and freight rail programs. This role requires a highly capable leader with deep expertise in managing large-scale conventional railway, freight rail, and associated infrastructure works. Key responsibilities include coordinating multidisciplinary teams, resolving complex technical and delivery interfaces, and ensuring execution aligns with project requirements for schedule, budget, quality, safety, and operational performance. The position demands substantial experience in delivering integrated works across conventional rail corridors, freight alignments, yards, depots, terminals, and associated infrastructure, including coordination of civil, structural, track, systems, MEP, architectural, utilities, and operational interfaces, while ensuring compliance with project specifications, applicable standards, regulatory requirements, and the operational needs of conventional and freight railway systems. Key Responsibilities Lead and manage the overall construction delivery of the railway program across multiple project packages, work fronts, or contractor interfaces. Drive site execution strategies to ensure safe, efficient, and timely delivery of all construction activities. Oversee and coordinate construction teams, subcontractors, package managers, and support functions to achieve program milestones. Ensure strong integration between engineering, procurement, construction, commercial, planning, contracts, and project controls functions. Monitor construction progress and productivity, implementing recovery plans where required to address delays or performance gaps. Manage site-related risks, constructability issues, sequencing constraints, logistics challenges, and interface coordination across the program. Lead delivery reviews, construction progress meetings, and reporting processes to ensure transparency and timely decision-making. Ensure construction activities are executed in compliance with project specifications, contractual requirements, quality standards, and HSE regulations. Support the development of construction methodologies, phasing plans, mobilization strategies, and execution plans during bid and post-award stages. Act as a key point of contact for internal stakeholders, contractors, consultants, and the client on all matters related to delivery and construction performance. Promote a strong site culture focused on safety, quality, productivity, accountability, and delivery excellence. Support testing, commissioning readiness, and handover planning in coordination with relevant teams, where required. Qualifications and Skills Over 10 years of experience in project delivery, with a strong focus on construction execution in complex railway environments. Proven ability to manage complex railway works in live and challenging environments, driving site performance and managing contractors and interfaces. Prior conventional railway and freight rail project experience is essential. Gulf experience is preferred. Strong understanding of construction sequencing, site logistics, temporary works, constructability, project controls, and commercial impacts on delivery. Demonstrated ability to manage complex construction interfaces and multidisciplinary teams in large project environments. Excellent leadership, stakeholder management, communication, and problem-solving skills. Strong knowledge of HSE, quality, risk, compliance, and construction best practices in major infrastructure projects, including the requirements of conventional and freight railway systems. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. SYSTRA is an equal opportunities company, and this position is open to all applicants.

68ba0af940c6f164.description: The Warehouse Chemist is responsible for ensuring the safe, compliant, and efficient management of chemicals and dangerous goods within warehouse operations. The role oversees the receipt, inspection, classification, storage, handling, and disposal of hazardous materials while ensuring compliance with local and international chemical safety regulations. The Warehouse Chemist provides technical expertise to support warehouse operations, minimize risks, maintain regulatory compliance, and promote best practices in chemical management. The position also supports audits, emergency response activities, and continuous improvement initiatives related to hazardous materials management. Key Responsibilities Receive, inspect, identify, classify, and verify chemicals and dangerous goods to ensure compliance with purchase specifications and regulatory requirements. Ensure the safe storage, segregation, handling, and transportation of chemicals in accordance with applicable safety standards and regulations. Conduct routine inspections of chemical storage areas and recommend corrective actions to address safety, environmental, and compliance risks. Monitor chemical inventory, shelf life, storage conditions, and maintain accurate records, Safety Data Sheets (SDS), and regulatory documentation. Assess chemical compatibility and perform risk assessments to minimize hazards and support safe warehouse operations. Coordinate the safe disposal of expired, obsolete, or hazardous chemicals in compliance with environmental and regulatory requirements. Provide technical guidance and awareness training to warehouse personnel on chemical safety, hazardous material handling, PPE, and emergency response procedures. Collaborate with Procurement, HSE, Logistics, and regulatory authorities to ensure compliance, support audits, investigate incidents, and continuously improve chemical management practices. Bachelor's degree in Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Pharmacy, Medical Laboratory Science, Chemical Technology, or a related scientific discipline. Minimum of four (4) years of experience in chemical warehouse operations, hazardous materials management, laboratory, or industrial chemical environments. Strong knowledge of chemical properties, hazard classification, compatibility, and hazardous material handling practices. Familiarity with applicable regulations, including GHS, IATA Dangerous Goods Regulations (DGR), IMDG Code, ADR, and local regulatory requirements. Proficiency in interpreting and applying Safety Data Sheets (SDS) and implementing safe chemical storage and segregation practices. Experience conducting chemical risk assessments, incident investigations, and implementing corrective and preventive actions. Good understanding of warehouse operations, inventory management systems, hazardous waste management, and environmental compliance. Strong communication, analytical, problem-solving, and documentation skills, with proficiency in Microsoft Office and warehouse management systems.

681fe5c85c741bf7.description: The Manager – Distribution at Qiddiya Investment Company will play a critical role in developing, managing, and optimizing Qiddiya DMO’s multi-channel distribution ecosystem. This role is responsible for driving the operational and commercial performance of all B2B and B2C booking channels, including OTAs, GDS platforms, travel trade networks, corporate travel channels, and direct booking platforms, ensuring Qiddiya’s tourism and destination products are accessible, competitively positioned, and commercially successful across all target markets. The role involves leading distribution strategy initiatives, managing channel partnerships and performance, optimizing pricing and inventory management practices, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to maximize revenue generation and customer reach. The Manager – Distribution will work closely with Partnerships, Marketing, Technology, Finance, and Operations teams while managing and mentoring the Distribution team. Responsibilities Lead the development and execution of Qiddiya’s B2B and B2C distribution strategy across OTA platforms, GDS systems, travel trade channels, corporate travel partners, and direct booking channels to support overall commercial objectives. Define and manage channel prioritization strategies to ensure optimal inventory allocation, rate parity, product visibility, and revenue performance across all distribution touchpoints. Develop and oversee channel mix strategies that balance direct and indirect distribution channels to optimize profitability, market reach, and customer acquisition. Manage Qiddiya’s OTA portfolio, including onboarding new platforms, negotiating commercial agreements, optimizing content quality, and improving product visibility and conversion performance. Oversee GDS connectivity and ensure Qiddiya’s tourism inventory is accurately represented and bookable across key global distribution systems for corporate and agency markets. Collaborate with Revenue Management, Finance, and Marketing teams to implement pricing strategies, promotional campaigns, and yield optimization initiatives across all channels. Monitor booking trends, demand patterns, conversion metrics, cancellation trends, and competitor activity to recommend real-time pricing and distribution adjustments. Develop and maintain distribution performance dashboards and reporting frameworks tracking revenue contribution, booking pace, channel conversion, cost of sale, and commercial KPIs. Lead the onboarding and management of travel agencies, tour operators, DMCs, MICE operators, and other trade distribution partners to strengthen Qiddiya’s global distribution footprint. Oversee the enhancement and management of trade distribution platforms and partner portals, ensuring partners have access to inventory, booking tools, commission tracking, and marketing materials. Coordinate partner training programs, trade familiarization (FAM) trips, and channel engagement initiatives to strengthen destination awareness and partner performance. Own and manage the distribution technology ecosystem, including Channel Management Systems (CMS), Central Reservation Systems (CRS), OTA connectivity tools, and booking platforms, ensuring operational efficiency and system optimization. Collaborate with Technology teams to improve platform integrations, distribution capabilities, and booking experiences across digital channels. Prepare and present regular distribution performance reports, channel reviews, forecasts, and strategic recommendations to senior leadership and key stakeholders. Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance distribution processes, channel performance, operational efficiencies, and commercial outcomes. Manage, mentor, and develop team members within the Distribution function to ensure high performance and professional growth. Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Tourism, Hospitality Management, Marketing, or a related field; Master’s degree or MBA preferred. At least 6+ years of relevant experience in distribution, revenue management, channel management, or commercial operations within tourism, hospitality, travel technology, or destination management sectors. Proven experience managing OTA platforms, GDS connectivity, trade distribution channels, and booking ecosystems at a destination, hospitality, or tourism organization level. Strong understanding of channel management systems, central reservation systems, revenue optimization practices, and dynamic pricing strategies. Demonstrated experience in developing and managing trade distribution relationships with travel agencies, tour operators, DMCs, and corporate travel partners. Strong analytical and commercial acumen with the ability to interpret performance metrics, optimize channel performance, and drive revenue growth initiatives. Excellent stakeholder management, negotiation, communication, and relationship-building skills with the ability to collaborate across multiple functions. Demonstrated leadership capability with experience managing teams and cross-functional initiatives. Proficiency in distribution systems, CRM platforms, reporting tools, and data analytics platforms including Excel and Power BI. Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English; Arabic language skills are considered an advantage. Knowledge of GCC and Saudi Arabia tourism, hospitality, and destination distribution landscape is strongly preferred.
